purpose: City-level map pins for official/theme development. Coordinates are approximate city-level only, not datacenter streets. Do not treat country centroids as precise locations.
sources_used: product or inventory city hints where already documented

public_remark_support.public_api: GET /api/nodes includes public_remark; admin can read/update it
public_remark_support.reason_not_written: Existing public_remark already holds traffic/plan notes. This file is the mapping source for theme development; writing a second JSON convention into remarks was left untouched to avoid overwriting those notes or conflicting with independent theme work.

overlap_policy: Same-city nodes should be aggregated or listed by the theme, not spread with invented street offsets.

nodes.name: RakSmart VIP
nodes.source: All three public geolocation sources agree on San Jose, California. Representative city-level point ~37.3394,-121.8950 (ipinfo loc; geojs 37.3388,-121.8916 accuracy 20; ipwho 37.3393854,-121.894959). No separate product city.

nodes.name: RakSmart CN2
nodes.source: All three public geolocation sources agree on San Jose, California, same city group as VIP. Representative city-level point ~37.3394,-121.8950 (geojs accuracy 20). Theme should aggregate with VIP, not invent a street offset.

nodes.name: RakSmart 双 ISP
nodes.source: Public geolocation conflicts and includes a well-known US country fallback. ipinfo: Iola, Kansas 37.9245,-95.4000; geojs: no city, 37.751,-97.822 accuracy 1000 (common US country default); ipwho.is: Washington, DC 38.8951121,-77.0363706. Inventory only states NTT US, no verifiable datacenter city. Do not pin and do not use a country centroid as a precise location.

nodes.name: 美国住宅
nodes.source: Product name LAX-BGP plus all three public geolocation sources agree on Los Angeles. Representative city-center point ~34.0522,-118.2437 (ipinfo/ipwho; geojs 34.0544,-118.244 accuracy 20).

nodes.name: 美国 CMIN2
nodes.source: Product name LAX-CUII plus all three public geolocation sources agree on Los Angeles. Public-IP city points range about 34.0515 to 34.0559, -118.2437 to -118.2707 (geojs accuracy 20). Mapped to the same Los Angeles city-center representative point as 美国住宅 for aggregation; not a distinct street coordinate. A historical rDNS label mentioning sfo1 does not override the product city and geolocation consensus.

nodes.name: 福云
nodes.source: Product 香港特价 plus all three public geolocation sources agree on Hong Kong. Representative city-center point ~22.2783,114.1747 (ipinfo/ipwho; geojs 22.2842,114.1759 accuracy 20). Not a district or street.

nodes.name: 阿里云北京
nodes.source: Product 阿里云北京 plus all three public geolocation sources agree on Beijing. Representative city-center point ~39.9075,116.3972 (ipinfo/ipwho; geojs 39.911,116.395 accuracy 20). Not an availability-zone or street.

nodes.name: 极点云
nodes.source: Product only states 美国轻量云, no official city. ipinfo and ipwho.is agree on Los Angeles city-center 34.0522,-118.2437; geojs has no city and returns 37.751,-97.822 accuracy 1000 (US country default), so that source is not used as a pin. Medium confidence city-level approximation; aggregate with other Los Angeles nodes.
